queries:
SELECT p.bats,
       COUNT(*) AS cnt,
       CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM appearances a2 JOIN player p2 ON a2.player_id = p2.player_id) AS fraction_of_total,
       CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / (SELECT AVG(c) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM appearances a3 JOIN player p3 ON a3.player_id = p3.player_id GROUP BY p3.bats)) AS ratio_to_avg
FROM appearances a
JOIN player p ON a.player_id = p.player_id
GROUP BY p.bats;
WITH c AS (
  SELECT bats, COUNT(*) AS n
  FROM player
  WHERE bats IN ('L', 'R', 'B')
  GROUP BY bats
)
SELECT bats, n, (SELECT SUM(n) FROM c) AS total, (SELECT AVG(n) FROM c) AS avg_per_hand
FROM c;
SELECT bats, COUNT(*) AS num_players
FROM player
GROUP BY bats
UNION ALL
SELECT 'AVERAGE', AVG(c)
FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM player WHERE bats IS NOT NULL GROUP BY bats)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'TOTAL', COUNT(*)
FROM player;
SELECT COUNT(*) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT p.bats) FROM player p JOIN batting b ON p.player_id = b.player_id;
SELECT p.bats, COUNT(DISTINCT a.player_id) AS count
FROM all_star a
JOIN player p ON a.player_id = p.player_id
GROUP BY p.bats;
